title: Every fragrance-free skincare option for sensitive skin under $35
prompt: I have very sensitive skin and I'm rebuilding my whole routine. Can you list every skincare product in your store (cleansers, toners, serums, moisturizers and sunscreens) that is fragrance-free, is listed as suitable for sensitive skin, and costs me less than $35? Include every size that qualifies, as separate entries. I want to order today, so only things in stock.
output_format: Return a JSON object of the form {"variant_ids": ["..."]} listing the variant ID of every product size that meets all of my conditions. If nothing matches, return an empty list.
why_hard: An exhaustive search across five categories and about 140 variants, with 12 valid answers spread over 4 categories and more than 20 near-misses (sensitive-skin products that are not fragrance-free, sold-out sizes, sizes over the cap). Sizes count separately, and one Aurevia serum is only under $35 after the promotion.
traps: SRM-010-15ml: Aurevia at $31.00 list, pays $24.80 after the promotion (valid)
MST-016-15ml and MST-016-50ml: both sizes qualify and must both be listed
CLN-013-50ml: sold out, while its 150 ml size is valid
Many sensitive-skin products under $35 that are not fragrance-free
